description: This source file defines the PngBuilder class, a utility for constructing and encoding PNG images within the PDFsharp library. It includes methods for creating PNG builders from various data sources, setting pixel colors, storing textual metadata, and saving the constructed PNG to a stream or byte array. The file handles PNG specifics such as color types, compression, and chunk management.

classes.name: PngBuilder
classes.description: A class to construct PNG images by setting pixels, encoding image data, and writing PNG chunks, with support for metadata and various pixel data sources.

classes.name: PngBuilder.SaveOptions
classes.description: Options for configuring the PNG saving process, including attempt at compression and parallelism control.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new PNG builder with specified width, height, and alpha channel support.

methods.name: FromPng
methods.description: Creates a PNG builder initialized from an existing Png object.

methods.name: FromPngBytes
methods.description: Creates a PNG builder from raw PNG byte array.

methods.name: FromBgra32Pixels
methods.description: Creates a PNG builder from BGRA32 pixel data, either from byte array or stream.

methods.name: SetPixel
methods.description: Sets the RGB or Pixel object value at specified coordinates.

methods.name: StoreText
methods.description: Stores metadata text in the PNG as an iTXt chunk.

methods.name: Save
methods.description: Returns PNG file bytes or writes PNG data to a stream.
